title: The Impossible Tide
author: Silas Oyelaran
blurb: Jonah Thackeray, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
